title: Productization sync scratch — roadmap handoff (inez)
content:
Purpose / context:
- Prep notes for cross-functional sync: product + eng (serving runtime) + applied-ml. Aim is a tight handoff from research experiments into a production rollout plan for the next 3 roadmap milestones (May, Jun, Jul).
- Focus areas: model parity vs baseline, latency SLOs, quantization risk, canary/rollback strategy, observability hooks and experiment metrics.

Meeting logistics:
- Tentative: Thu 2026-04-30, 09:30–10:30 PT (30m focused + 30m breakout).
- Attendees (invited): Inez (prod), Marcus (serving runtime), Sofia (applied-ml), Diego (infra), Aisha (SRE), Tom (console), + 2 TBD (solutions eng, release eng).
- Pre-reads (please skim before meeting):
  * ML-ROADMAP-2026 (Confluence) — especially sections "variant parity" and "staging metrics".
  * PR #982 (runtime changes for KV cache) — diff + perf numbers.
  * Experiment dashboard: staging/quant-3 (link in RDW-1214).

High-level goal for sync:
1) Agree acceptance criteria to promote quantized-2 models from staging -> canary.
2) Lock on latency budget per SKU (p50/p95) and degradation tolerance during canary.
3) Define minimal observability and regression tests required before 1st canary.
4) Assign owners and dates for rollout checklist items.

Agenda (30m):
- 09:30 (5m) Quick framing: why this matters now (Inez) — customer signals + cost pressure.
- 09:35 (10m) Applied-ML update (Sofia): perf delta vs fp16 baseline, known failure modes, dataset gaps.
- 09:45 (10m) Serving runtime constraints (Marcus): batching/kv-cache behavior with quantized weights; estimated tail latency impact.
- 09:55 (5m) Proposed canary plan brief (Diego): infra capacity and safety nets.

Breakouts (30m):
- Breakout A: Prod checklist (Tom + Aisha + Inez) — SLA targets, monitoring, alerts, rollback triggers.
- Breakout B: Experiment to canary handoff (Sofia + Marcus + solutions eng) — tests, data gating, perf regressions.

Assumptions (call out):
- Quantized-2 yields ~20% token-cost reduction vs fp16 on target hardware (A100-40GB equiv).
- Generalization gap currently small for dev data but unknown for long-tail customer prompts.
- We have capacity to run a staged canary at ~5% traffic in dedicated pool.

Open questions (we must resolve in sync or immediately after):
1) What is the hard p95 latency SLO we will enforce for canary? (suggestion: +15% above baseline p95, but absolute cap at 350ms).
2) Required size and composition of prompt-set for automated quality checks (Sofia to propose).
3) Do we require end-to-end A/B (compare outputs) or is sampling-based rollback acceptable initially?
4) Is there a guardrail to prevent serving quantized variants for customers with strict accuracy constraints (flagged via account metadata)?

Decision items (to decide in meeting):
- D1: Canary staging date window (target week of 2026-05-11) — tentative.
- D2: Acceptance thresholds for canary (p50, p95, quality regression thresholds).
- D3: Minimal observability matrix (metrics + traces + example-compare pipeline).

Experiment / rollout matrix (quick):
- Stage: internal benchmark (done) | Lead: Sofia | Done-by: 2026-04-27 | Pass: perf delta < +10% latency, quality drop < 1% (top-1).
- Stage: extended staging (50 workload profiles) | Lead: Marcus | Done-by: 2026-05-04 | Pass: tail latency < 350ms and no new errors >0.1%.
- Stage: canary (5% traffic) | Lead: Diego | Window: 2026-05-11–2026-05-18 | Pass: no rollback triggers after 48h.

Observability required (minimum):
- Per-model p50/p95 token latency, per-route throughput, error-rate by route, example-diff drift metric (automated), and a sample of decoded outputs with golden references.
- Alerts: error-rate > 0.5% in 15m OR p95 > 400ms for 5m -> paging to oncall.
- Dashboards: canary dashboard with side-by-side baseline vs quantized metrics + output-diff sampler.

Concrete action items (post-meeting follow-ups):
- I1: Sofia: finalize prompt-set (200 prompts split by intent) + add guardrail test scripts. Due: 2026-05-01.
- I2: Marcus: instrument runtime to emit example-diff hashes and add percentile latency hooks for per-account. Due: 2026-05-03.
- I3: Diego: reserve dedicated canary pool + rollback automation runbook. Due: 2026-05-06.
- I4: Tom: build temporary canary dashboard + hook example sampler. Due: 2026-05-08.
- I5: Inez: draft customer communication template for opt-in/opt-out and internal launch note. Due: 2026-05-07.
- I6: Aisha: update SRE runbook with new alert thresholds and paging rules. Due: 2026-05-05.

Risks and mitigation (notes to call out):
- Risk: Long-tail prompts degrade in ways not covered by staging prompts. Mitigation: expand prompt-set and run small private-customer shadow test.
- Risk: Quantization introduces non-determinism in rare tokens -> false positives in diff metric. Mitigation: use semantic similarity threshold rather than exact token-match for alerts.
- Risk: Rollout triggers noisy alerts and churn oncall. Mitigation: 48h cool window and automated temporary scaling instead of immediate rollback for transient spikes.

Communication plan (internal + external):
- Internal: 1-pager to eng leads + oncall + solutions eng before canary (Inez).
- External: small note to pilot customers with ability to opt-out; include link to feedback form and contact (solutions eng).

Notes / personal to-dos during meeting:
- Keep canary conservative: prefer multiple short canaries over a long open canary.
- Track one canonical example that must remain stable ("anchor case").
- Draw a simple decision tree in whiteboard when discussing rollback (automate if possible).

Follow-up meeting suggestions:
- Quick standup 2026-05-09 (15m) to confirm readiness and blockers.
- Canary review: 2026-05-18 (30m) to review metrics and decide full promotion.

Scratch pad (random thoughts):
- Could we toggle quantization by user tier? maybe start with non-enterprise accounts to reduce risk.
- Consider a model tagging convention: q2-2026-<base-model>-<git-hash> to make audits reproducible.
- If example-diff drift is noisy, fall back to a human-in-the-loop review for first 72h.

End-of-note: keep this doc terse in meeting, expand into a short Confluence playbook afterwards (Inez to own).

---
Recent edits log:
- 2026-04-24: initial draft and agenda (Inez).
- 2026-04-25: added experiment matrix + action items after quick sync with Marcus.
